# FDG9016

> CONSIDER separating aggregate components and factored types into different assemblies.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: how types are factored into assemblies is an architecture decision.

## From the book

This allows the component to aggregate arbitrary functionality provided by factored types without circular dependencies.
